description: Asked to find the actual AI Adoption Maturity Assessment (after the bootcamp Pre-Work.md bad-link correction, err-20261009T203817-J2YY3F), Master located a 21-question instrument embedded in AI-Self-Directed-Learning/Module-4-Completion/Exercise-16 (Step 5, 'AI Adoption Stage Evaluation') and presented it as the actual assessment. David corrected: that is not it either. The real assessment is a separate document provided by the facilitator and is not a repository file.
correction: The AI Adoption Maturity Assessment is facilitator-provided, not on disk. Do not declare a plausible-looking artifact 'the actual assessment' based on surface match (question count, dimension count). When the source of truth is a document a human hands out, say so and stop searching the filesystem.
systemic_fix: When hunting a referenced document, match on provenance (who issues it, how it is administered) as well as structure. A structural lookalike from a different program (SDL company-wide vocabulary vs DLP instrument) is a candidate to report, not an answer to declare.
